predefined_info.altitude: Elevation (m) from the [NASA SRTM 30 m](https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/datasets/catalog/USGS_SRTMGL1_003) digital elevation model, clipped to your AOI. Continuous.
predefined_info.slope: Terrain slope (degrees) computed from the [NASA SRTM 30 m](https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/datasets/catalog/USGS_SRTMGL1_003) elevation with Earth Engine's `ee.Terrain.slope`. Continuous.
predefined_info.protected_area: Binary mask (1 = inside a protected area) built by rasterizing the designated/inscribed/established/proposed polygons of the [WDPA — World Database on Protected Areas](https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/datasets/catalog/WCMC_WDPA_current_polygons).
predefined_info.rivers: Binary mask of water from the [OSM Water Layer](https://gee-community-catalog.org/projects/osm_water/), clipped to your AOI. By default large lakes and rivers, major rivers, canals and small streams count as water (ocean excluded); change the classes under Advanced parameters.
predefined_info.roads: Binary road mask (1 = road), clipped to your AOI. By default roads are rasterized from [OpenStreetMap](https://www.openstreetmap.org/), with no breakdown by road type. Under *Advanced parameters* you can switch to **GRIP4**, the Global Roads Inventory Project (Meijer et al. 2018, [Environ. Res. Lett. 13 064006](https://doi.org/10.1088/1748-9326/aabd42); PBL/GLOBIO, CC BY 4.0, via the [awesome-gee-community-catalog](https://gee-community-catalog.org/projects/grip/)), and choose which road types to keep. GRIP4 is a ~2018 snapshot compiled from national sources: it maps far fewer minor and unpaved roads than OSM and road-type definitions vary by country, so some AOIs have no roads of a given type (e.g. no highways).
predefined_info.forest_gfc: Forest/non-forest mask (1 = forest) for the chosen year, derived from [Hansen Global Forest Change](https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/datasets/catalog/UMD_hansen_global_forest_change_2025_v1_13): pixels above the tree-cover threshold in 2000 minus loss up to that year. Temporal.
predefined_info.forest_tmf: Forest/non-forest mask (1 = forest) at 1 January of the chosen year from the [JRC Tropical Moist Forest](https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/datasets/catalog/projects_JRC_TMF_v1_2024_AnnualChanges) annual-change product. By default only undisturbed forest counts; Advanced parameters can add degraded forest and regrowth. Temporal.
predefined_info.towns: Binary urban-area mask (1 = built-up + populated) for the nearest epoch, from [JRC GHSL](https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/datasets/catalog/JRC_GHSL_P2023A_GHS_BUILT_S) population and built-surface layers. Temporal (5-year epochs).
predefined_info.subj: Categorical raster of level-2 administrative subjurisdictions from [FAO GAUL](https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/datasets/catalog/FAO_GAUL_2015_level2), each zone given a distinct value. Used for JNR-style stratification.
predefined_info.precipitation: Total precipitation (mm) for the chosen year or month: the sum of the [ERA5-Land Monthly Aggregates](https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/datasets/catalog/ECMWF_ERA5_LAND_MONTHLY_AGGR) totals (default, ~11 km) or of [CHIRPS Daily](https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/datasets/catalog/UCSB-CHG_CHIRPS_DAILY) rainfall (~5.5 km, 50°S–50°N only). Data: Copernicus Climate Change Service / Climate Hazards Center UCSB. Continuous. Temporal.
predefined_info.temperature_2m: Air temperature at 2 m (°C) for the chosen year or month. A year combines the 12 monthly means of [ERA5-Land Monthly Aggregates](https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/datasets/catalog/ECMWF_ERA5_LAND_MONTHLY_AGGR); a month combines its daily means from [ERA5-Land Daily Aggregates](https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/datasets/catalog/ECMWF_ERA5_LAND_DAILY_AGGR), with the chosen aggregation metric (~11 km). Data: Copernicus Climate Change Service. Continuous. Temporal.
predefined_info.burned_area: Binary mask (1 = burned) of the pixels burned during the chosen year or month, from the monthly burned-area products [MODIS MCD64A1](https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/datasets/catalog/MODIS_061_MCD64A1) (default, from Nov 2000) or [VIIRS VNP64A1](https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/datasets/catalog/NASA_VIIRS_002_VNP64A1) (from Mar 2012), ~463 m. Data: NASA LP DAAC. Temporal.
predefined_info.active_fire: Active-fire detections in the chosen year or month: any detection (1 = fire), the number of fire days, or the maximum fire radiative power (MW). Sources: [MODIS MOD14A1 + MYD14A1](https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/datasets/catalog/MODIS_061_MOD14A1) (Terra + Aqua, default), [VIIRS VNP14A1](https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/datasets/catalog/NASA_VIIRS_002_VNP14A1) or [NASA FIRMS](https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/datasets/catalog/FIRMS) (no radiative power), ~1 km. Data: NASA LP DAAC / NASA FIRMS (LANCE). Temporal.
predefined_info.fire_history: Fire history at the start of the chosen year or month, looking back the chosen number of years: how many of those 12-month spans had fire, or the whole years since the last fire (capped at the look-back). Built from [MODIS MCD64A1](https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/datasets/catalog/MODIS_061_MCD64A1) burned area (default) or MODIS active fires, ~463 m / ~1 km. The period itself is never included, so the layer can explain a fire target of the same period. Data: NASA LP DAAC. Temporal.
predefined_info.dry_spell: Dryness at the start of the chosen year or month, from daily rainfall over the look-back window: days since the last day with at least the rain threshold (capped at the window), the number of dry days, or the total rain (mm). Sources: [CHIRPS Daily](https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/datasets/catalog/UCSB-CHG_CHIRPS_DAILY) (default, ~5.5 km, covers 50°S–50°N only: AOIs outside get no data) or [ERA5-Land Daily Aggregates](https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/datasets/catalog/ECMWF_ERA5_LAND_DAILY_AGGR) (~11 km, global). Results depend strongly on the source and the threshold. Data: Climate Hazards Center UCSB / Copernicus Climate Change Service. Temporal.

modal.source_hint: Predefined = ready-made Earth Engine layers; User = your own raster, vector or GEE asset.
modal.param_tree_cover_threshold_hint: Minimum canopy cover in 2000 counted as forest (1-100). It becomes part of the variable name, so several thresholds can coexist.
modal.param_aggregation_hint: How the values are combined: the 12 monthly means for a whole year, or the daily means for a single month. It becomes part of the variable name, so several metrics can coexist.
modal.param_roads_source_hint: OpenStreetMap (default) is the most complete. GRIP4 (~2018) is sparser but lets you choose road types. A non-default source becomes part of the variable name (roads_grip).
modal.param_road_types_hint: GRIP4 road classes counted as road. A subset becomes part of the variable name, e.g. roads_grip_rhp = highways + primary roads. Types absent from your AOI give an all-zero layer.
modal.custom_type_hint: Local raster file = GeoTIFF on disk; Google Earth Engine asset = GEE asset; Local vector file = vector file, rasterized during harmonization.
modal.custom_year_hint: Set for temporal layers so the same variable can be added per year; leave blank for static ones.
modal.custom_scale_hint: Nominal pixel size in metres used when exporting this GEE asset.
modal.band_hint: This raster has {count} bands; the layer uses only the one picked here.
modal.custom_raster_type_hint: continuous = measured values (e.g. elevation); categorical = classes or 0/1 masks.
modal.stretch_hint: Reads the layer's percentiles (an Earth Engine asset over the AOI) and fills Min and Max. Leave both empty to stretch automatically.
modal.find_classes: Find the classes in the layer
modal.find_classes_hint: Lists the values found in a sample of the layer (an Earth Engine asset over the AOI). A rare value can be missed: add it by hand. Values not listed are transparent.
modal.find_features_hint: Lists one class per feature, in file order, named from the file's first text column; features not listed are transparent.
modal.err_too_many_features: More than 50 features: the layer is drawn with automatic colours.
modal.zero_one_note: Only 0 and 1 were found: 0 starts hidden (transparent). Click its eye to draw it.
modal.err_class_value: Enter a whole number not already listed.
modal.err_no_classes: Find the classes or add a value.
modal.err_duplicate_class: Each value can be listed once.
modal.err_class_limit: A categorical layer holds at most 50 classes.
modal.err_range: Min and Max must be numbers, Min below Max, or both empty.
modal.err_not_integer: This layer has non-integer values: set its raster type to continuous.
modal.err_too_many_classes: More than 50 values: this layer looks continuous.
modal.err_no_stretch: The layer has no spread of values.
modal.probe_failed: Could not read the layer's values: {error}
modal.custom_rasterization_method_hint: binary = 1 where a feature is present, 0 elsewhere; unique = one value per feature/class.
modal.error_no_predefined_selected: Select a variable from the list.
modal.error_year_required: Year is required for this variable.
modal.error_param_range: {label} must be a whole number between {min} and {max}.
modal.param_water_classes_hint: OSM Water Layer classes mapped as water (1). A non-default selection adds a code to the variable name (e.g. rivers_wlmc).
modal.param_tmf_definition_hint: TMF classes counted as forest. A non-default choice is added to the variable name (e.g. forest_tmf_degraded).
modal.error_param_multichoice: Select at least one option for {label}.
modal.param_period_hint: Whole year, or one calendar month of the chosen year. A month becomes part of the variable name (e.g. _sep), so one model per month can be built.
modal.param_burn_sensor_hint: MODIS MCD64A1 (from Nov 2000) or VIIRS VNP64A1 (from Mar 2012, detects more small burns). Both ~463 m.
modal.param_fire_metric_hint: Any detection gives a 0/1 mask; fire days counts the days with a detection; maximum radiative power is the strongest fire seen (MW).
modal.param_fire_confidence_hint: Lowest detection confidence counted as fire. The default keeps nominal and high confidence.
modal.param_fire_source_hint: MODIS Terra + Aqua (from Mar 2000), VIIRS (from Feb 2012) or NASA FIRMS (MODIS-based, no radiative power). All ~1 km.
modal.param_history_metric_hint: Fire years counts the 12-month spans with fire in the look-back; years since fire is the number of whole years since the last fire.
modal.param_history_window_hint: How many years before the period start are examined (1-20). It becomes part of the variable name.
modal.param_history_source_hint: MODIS burned area (MCD64A1, ~463 m) or MODIS active fires (~1 km, nominal and high confidence).
modal.param_dry_metric_hint: Days since rain counts the dry days just before the period start; dry days counts every dry day in the window; total rain sums the rain in the window.
modal.param_rain_threshold_hint: A day with at least this much rain counts as a rain day (1-50).
modal.param_dry_window_hint: Days before the period start that are examined (7-999). Days since rain is capped at this value.
modal.param_rain_source_hint: ERA5-Land (~11 km, global) or CHIRPS (~5.5 km, 50°S–50°N only; AOIs outside get no data).
modal.error_period_unavailable: No data for {year}: this layer needs {start} to {end}, and the selected source covers {first} to {last}. Pick another year, period or source.
modal.error_frp_firms: NASA FIRMS has no fire radiative power. Choose MODIS or VIIRS as the source, or another measure.
